name: io.github.maxime-desmarchelier/fr-grocery-mcp
title: French Grocery
description: Search, compare and manage E.Leclerc Drive and Super U grocery carts without ordering.

environmentVariables.name: FR_GROCERY_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the optional JSON configuration file. Without it, only Super U is enabled.

environmentVariables.name: FR_GROCERY_CHROME_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Chrome DevTools Protocol port; overrides the configuration file.

environmentVariables.name: FR_GROCERY_STATE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for retailer state such as the selected Leclerc store.
